notes.title: Demo Is Available Again
notes.notes: [p]Previously, our Elemental Towers demo was only accessible during Steam Next Fest, and we had to disable it on June 16. However, we noticed that many of you didn’t have enough time to fully explore the game and experience its unique gameplay.[/p][p]That’s why we’re excited to announce that starting today, the demo is open to everyone once again![/p][p]But don’t wait too long — the demo will be available for only two weeks, until July 2 inclusive. Jump in now, immerse yourself in the world of Elemental Towers, and show us what you’ve got![/p]

notes.title: LIVE Stream Starts Today at 19:00 CET
notes.notes: [p]Hey friends! Today’s a big day — we’re kicking off our first official gameplay stream for Elemental Towers! Tune in at [b]19:00[/b] CET on our Steam page to see the magic in action.[/p][p]We started with a dream and a prototype, and now we’re sharing live gameplay with you. Excited? Drop by, cheer us on, and don’t forget: a wishlist means the world to our team.[/p][p][/p][p]See you there, mages![/p]

notes.title: Demo Available Now
notes.notes:
[p][b]Hey friends![/b]
Our [b]game demo[/b] is live on Steam and part of [b]Steam Next Fest[/b]!
We started in 2023 with a rough prototype and big dreams. Now our first demo is out, and we’d love your feedback![/p][p][b]Next week:[/b] our [b]first trailer drops on IGN[/b] — stay tuned!
Tried the demo and liked it? Wishlist, share, or drop us a message — it really helps.[/p][p]Thanks for your support![/p]
